decision.explanation: The original sources provide conflicting claims about the composer of Symphony No. 38. Document D1S3 explicitly states that Symphony No. 38 in C major is by Joseph Haydn. Document D5S4 attributes Symphony No. 38 in D major to Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Document D7S2 identifies Michael Haydn as the composer of Symphony No. 38 in F major. These are distinct works with the same title number but different composers and keys, so they represent separate valid referents. Ludwig van Beethoven is incorrectly cited in D4S4 as the composer of Symphony No. 38, which is unsupported by any direct evidence in the provided sources.
